newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends at highs, funds cover shorts.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends at highs, funds cover shorts.

text.p: CSCE world sugar closed a heavily-traded session near the day's highs, as the funds covered short positions in March, fueling the contract to a nearly one-month high, dealers said.
The action carried the spot contract over several levels of resistance to end at to 10.69, up 0.23, traded 10.71 to 10.50. The back months finished 0.18 to 0.13 firmer.

Traders said speculative buying on the open lifted March over firm resistance at 10.50 to 10.54, which set the day's tone. The funds and commission houses continued to press the market higher throughout the morning, while trade scale-up selling capped the rally at 10.70.

Local profit taking and a dwindling number of buyers pressured March to 10.62, but the speculators again brought the contract up to 10.70. Immediately before the close, they pierced the day's highs and carried the contract to 10.71.

Despite the close near the day's high, prices are not likely to climb much further, market sources said. "I'm not sure how much further the market can go because the run-up was strictly technical in nature," a trader said.
He noted a gap between Monday's close of 10.48 and today's open at 10.50. "That suggests we may have to pull back to fill the gap and from there, make another attempt to the upside."
